summary.zh: 为新界面给出清晰的视觉方向与排版方案
summary.en: Set a clear visual direction and type system for new UI.

description.zh: 在新建或改造界面时提供审美方向、字体层级和配色决策，让成品不像套用默认模板。适合从零搭页面、或现有界面观感平庸需要重做视觉时使用。
description.en: Offers aesthetic direction, type hierarchy and color decisions when building or reshaping an interface, so the result does not read as a default template. Useful when starting a page from scratch or when an existing screen looks generic.
